admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: Every place that decides whether an agent is in a turn.
conditions: Activity intake itself stays event-driven and reconciled once per boot.
The held-delivery tick reads the publication every three seconds for held delivery only.
exclusions: No idle status polling and no second status store exist for activity.
The tick's read is not an activity intake and publishes no status of its own.

statement: Bound role-agent activity is published from host transitions and reconciled once per boot; the activity publication is not polled for status, while the held-delivery tick reads it on its own short interval to see turn ends and to hold a message for a recipient reported in a turn.
